exclusions.name: Blood usage at hospital
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks for units received, not net after usage. Usage does not affect receipt count.

exclusions.name: Blood centre internal usage or losses
exclusions.why_safe: Even if some stock is used, the centre has ample surplus (220 units before Tuesday dispatch, 250 before Thursday) to send 150 each time. Any plausible loss would still leave enough.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or recipients
exclusions.why_safe: The centre's shipments are exclusively to St. Vincent per the distribution agreement. No other recipients are mentioned.

exclusions.name: Courier delays or failures
exclusions.why_safe: Transit time is given as about 3 hours, and shipments are dispatched on schedule. No evidence of delays.

exclusions.name: Elena Cruz's actions
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not affect collection or shipping schedule. Her actions do not change the number of units received.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre's stock at 4:00 PM Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Tuesday shipment. The centre starts with 40 units, collects 12 units/hour for 8 hours on Monday (96 units) and 7 hours on Tuesday (84 units) before 4:00 PM, totalling 220 units, which is enough. However, any unstated usage or losses could reduce stock.

Whether the centre's stock at 4:00 PM Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections) is at least 150 units. After Tuesday dispatch, centre stock is 220 - 150 = 70 units. Wednesday collection (8 hours) adds 96 units (total 166). Thursday collection before 4:00 PM (7 hours) adds 84 units (total 250). So enough, but again unstated usage could change.
Whether the Tuesday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon. Dispatched at 4:00 PM Tuesday, transit 3 hours, arrives 7:00 PM Tuesday. So received well before deadline.
Whether the Thursday shipment is received by Friday noon. Dispatched at 4:00 PM Thursday, arrives 7:00 PM Thursday. So received before deadline.
The hospital starts with 15 units at 9:00 AM Monday. No evidence of any usage or additional receipts besides the two shipments. So initial stock is 15 units.
